input: Find arts, music, theater, dance, STEM, academic and cooking summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Marion, Old Fort, Little Switzerland, Burnsville, Spruce Pine, Bakersville and Morganton, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Marion Old Fort McDowell summer camps 2026 arts STEM kids
Burnsville NC Parkway Playhouse summer camps 2026
Morganton music arts camp 2026 First Baptist
Morganton summer camps STEM 2026 Western Piedmont

candidates.name: Penland School of Craft
candidates.note: Kids’ art camps and teen workshops, ages 3–17, including clay, wood, textiles, drawing and painting.

candidates.name: Toe River Arts
candidates.note: Summer art camps include painting, sculpture and textiles; 2025 outdoor camps met at Celo Community Center.

candidates.name: Parkway Playhouse
candidates.note: Junior performing-arts summer camps and teen apprenticeships in theater production.

candidates.name: Camp Celo
candidates.note: Residential farm camp with crafts, woodshop, drama and outdoor activities; summer 2027 dates announced.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Yancey County 4-H
candidates.note: Ran a variety of supervised Summer Fun learning camps for youth in 2025.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Mitchell County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 camps included cooking, preservation, photography, crafts, electricity, robotics and kitchen chemistry, ages 5–18.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — McDowell County 4-H
candidates.note: Summer Discovery day camps teach practical skills; 2025 offerings included a three-day podcast camp.

candidates.name: Fig & Owl Studio
candidates.note: Ran an afternoon children’s clay camp at Arrowhead Gallery & Studios in July 2026.

candidates.name: The Industrial Commons — TOSS
candidates.note: 2026 morning camps for rising K–8 students combined science with sculpture, painting, printmaking, ceramics and fiber art.

candidates.name: Burke Arts Council
candidates.note: Children’s summer art camps and teen theater programming.

candidates.name: City of Morganton Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 camps included science and cultural-arts themes for ages 8–12, a younger mini-camp and a disability-inclusive camp.

candidates.name: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics
candidates.note: Early Accelerator day camps, residential Accelerator courses and INSPIRE research experiences for rising grades 5–12.

candidates.name: UNC Eshelman School of Pharmacy
candidates.note: Two-day PILLS Academy at Western Piedmont Community College in July 2026 for rising high-school juniors and seniors.

candidates.name: First United Methodist Church of Morganton
candidates.note: Music & Arts Camp for preschoolers through school-age children, jointly offered with First Presbyterian Church in 2025.

candidates.name: First Presbyterian Church of Morganton
candidates.note: Co-organized the July 2025 Music & Arts Camp held at First United Methodist Church.
